jsonld.name: Wales LTT Calculator
jsonld.description: Land Transaction Tax for property purchases in Wales using main residential, higher residential and non-residential rates.

mainEntity.name: Is there first-time buyer relief on LTT in Wales?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The £225,000 nil-rate band is the standard main-rate threshold for everyone buying a main residence, not a dedicated first-time buyer relief.

mainEntity.name: How do higher rates work in Wales?

acceptedAnswer.text: Since 11 December 2024 additional properties use a separate table starting at 5% on the first £180,000 — not a flat surcharge on the main rates.

mainEntity.name: Is LTT the same as stamp duty in England?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Different statute, different bands. For England and Northern Ireland use the UK Stamp Duty Calculator.

mainEntity.name: When do I have to pay LTT?

acceptedAnswer.text: The return must be filed and the tax paid to the Welsh Revenue Authority within 30 days of the day after completion — your solicitor normally does this for you.

mainEntity.name: Does this cover a shop or office?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — choose Non-Residential. From 22 December 2020 the slices are 0% to £225,000, 1% to £250,000, 5% to £1,000,000 and 6% above. A £300,000 premises is £2,750. Lease rent is not calculated.

mainEntity.name: Is this a Welsh Revenue Authority assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Confirm with a solicitor. This page is a planning estimate from published bands.
